query:
SELECT
            id         as "id!",
            app_id     as "app_id",
            event_type as "event_type!",
            payload    as "payload",
            created_at as "created_at!: _"
           FROM events
           WHERE (?1 IS NULL OR app_id = ?1)
             AND (?2 IS NULL OR created_at > ?2)
           ORDER BY created_at DESC
           LIMIT 1000
